title: Measures and stability in a model, revisited
summary: This article is written in celebration of the 8th Kazakh-French Logical Colloquium. We expand on an unpublished research note of the second author. We record some results concerning local Keisler measures with respect to a formula which is stable in a model. We prove that in this context, every local Keisler measure on the associated local type space is a weighted sum of (at most countably many) types.
